It does not waive any whole-model failure or identify the earlier operation responsible.

limitations: Full-mask intermediate gates fail in every implementation; final RGB success is not complete numerical qualification.
The public record characterizes eight deterministic synthetic fixtures and four cropped photographs, not perceptual quality on a representative dataset.
Two resolutions of the same two source photographs are four geometry/fixture cases, not four independent photographs.
The optimized configuration combines three default-off candidates; its end-to-end speedup does not isolate an individual candidate's contribution.
Short sequential warm benchmarks on one shared CPU host do not establish cross-machine performance or GPU behavior.
Measured child-process peak RSS includes that process's framework/model/storage; graph arena sizes alone and GGUF file sizes are not total runtime memory.
No CUDA, Metal, FP16/mixed profile or full-resolution1024-pixel inference was executed in this lane.
